# Keep patch state out of the loaded firmware image

Stores into the loaded program image have restarted cameras; stock firmware does not make them.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [ep7 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/ep7-1100.md), [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md), [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)

Keep runtime state in heap or .bss, not in the loaded program image. On the E-P7 a sweep of every absolute store found none into the image.

> **What happens:** Camera restart on first use; one OM-5 Mark II build then looped on every start until restored.

**Symptoms:** [Restarts or crashes when a feature runs](index.md#restart-in-use); [Fails to start, restarts or loops at power-on](index.md#start-failure)

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Caduceus for E-P7](../projects/caduceus-ep7.md)): A sweep of 32,217 absolute stores found none into the loaded image. Source: [E-P7 firmware guide](../sources/ep7.guide.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for E-P7](../projects/caduceus-ep7.md)): The one E-P7 build that stored into the image crashed; moving the state fixed it. Source: [E-P7 firmware guide](../sources/ep7.guide.md).
- **Static analysis** ([Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md)): An OM-5 Mark II build that froze and looped kept state in the image; stock E148 makes no such absolute store. Source: [Image-store fault investigation](../sources/om5.image-store.md).
- **Emulator** ([Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md)): After moving the state, emulator sessions showed no store into the image from patch code. Source: [Image-store fault investigation](../sources/om5.image-store.md).
